question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.

A person who is known for his hatred towards the entire mankind.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Misanthrope.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Misanthrope"** means a person who dislikes humankind and avoids human society. (मनुष्य-द्वेषी)

 
 
• **Example: **After years of disappointment, he turned into a misanthrope, shunning all social interactions.
 
 
 
• **"Insolvent" **refers to a person or organization that is unable to pay their debts. (दिवालिया)
 
 
• **Example: **The company went insolvent after it failed to secure new funding.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for a person who is known for his hatred towards the entire mankind is **'Misanthrope'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Insolvent **(दिवालिया): A person or organization that is unable to pay their debts.

 
 
• **Example:** The company declared itself insolvent after several years of heavy losses.
 
 
 
• **Philogynist **(नारीप्रेमी): A person who loves or admires women.
 
 
• **Example: **He was known as a philogynist due to his respectful and admiring attitude towards women.
 
 
 
• **Mercenary** (भाड़े का सिपाही): A person primarily concerned with making money at the expense of ethics.
 
 
• **Example:** He worked as a mercenary, taking on any job that paid well regardless of the consequences.
